name: ReSharpen: sample delta boost via preview callback
plain: Adds or subtracts a tenth of 'details' times each step's change in x during sampling, to change detail: positive details subtract. It works by replacing latent_preview.prepare_callback globally at import time and editing x in place inside the callback. So the method is tied to samplers passing the live x to the callback.
label: from code
surprise: Monkeypatches latent_preview.prepare_callback at import (resharpen.py:47) and mutates sampler state in a preview callback, via module-global strength.

audit.note: Constant and sign wrong. resharpen.py:71: RESHARPEN_STRENGTH = details / -10.0, so the multiplier is −details/10, not details. Positive details subtract the step change.
